reason: The corrected hostname socket passed native assembly. Package compilation, vulnerability admission, storage expansion and factory installation passed. Installed boot then failed systemd-boot-random-seed.service and the global boot failure check. The mandatory seed refresh writes to the ESP while the generated appliance mount policy keeps that filesystem read-only; the matching native bootctl reproduces the write failure.
